framework.label: Framework (QBCore, Qbox, ESX, vRP)
framework.description: Money, item, job, gang and revive actions. They need an up-to-date mri-botcreator resource, which detects the framework and translates. Gang doesn't apply on ESX (the core has none).

mriQbox.label: MRI Qbox (VIP)
mriQbox.description: Grants and removes a VIP tier through the mri_Qbox command. Only works on servers running mri_Qbox — with another VIP system, edit the action's command after importing.

vrp.label: vRP and Creative
vrp.description: Give and take a group (VIP, job, gang) on a vRP or Creative server. Money, item and vehicle use the Framework pack actions, which also work on vRP.

giveMoney.label: Give money
giveMoney.description: Deposits into the player's chosen account.

removeMoney.label: Take money
removeMoney.description: Removes from the player's chosen account.

giveItem.label: Give item
giveItem.description: Puts an item in the player's inventory.

removeItem.label: Take item
removeItem.description: Removes an item from the player's inventory.

setJob.label: Set job
setJob.description: Changes the player's job and grade.

setGang.label: Set gang
setGang.description: Changes the player's gang and grade (QBCore/Qbox).

revive.label: Revive
revive.description: Revives the player where they are.

giveVehicle.label: Give vehicle
giveVehicle.description: Puts a vehicle in the player's garage (QBCore, Qbox, vRP and Creative).

removeVehicle.label: Remove vehicle
removeVehicle.description: Takes the newest vehicle of this model out of the player's garage (QBCore, Qbox, vRP and Creative). Use it On expiry.

giveVip.label: Give VIP
giveVip.description: Activates a VIP tier on the player.

removeVip.label: Take VIP
removeVip.description: Removes a VIP tier from the player. The natural pair of "Give VIP" in role→action: it's added when the role is gained and removed when it's lost.

giveGroup.label: Give group
giveGroup.description: Puts the player in the group (VIP, job). Level 0 uses the group's default level.

removeGroup.label: Remove group
removeGroup.description: Takes the player out of the group. Use it On expiry so the VIP ends on time.
